bio: Giovanna Moraca was baptized on 1 March 1721, the daughter of Francesco Moraca and Lucrezia Manfrida. Her godfather, Don Giovanni Battista Bonaccia of Naples, stood for her by proxy. In 1738, at about sixteen, she married Bernardo Cicco.
